notes: Seeded from the Curiosity Pipeline 'Recommended Newsletters' companion doc. These are the reader's OWN subscriptions (subscribed=true): they set the quality/taste bar and seed discovery, but the pipeline's primary value is finding strong pieces BEYOND this list. 'weight' is tuned by the feedback loop (scripts/apply_feedback.py); higher = surface more. feed_url values are best guesses and are auto-rediscovered by scripts/fetch_feeds.py if they fail.

discovery.note: Use WebSearch to find recent long-form pieces in the target domains that are NOT from the subscribed sources below. This is where most of the differentiated value is.

sources.name: The Intrinsic Perspective
sources.author: Erik Hoel
sources.notes: Neuroscientist on consciousness, free will, philosophy of mind, information theory. Bold, rigorous, surprising.

sources.name: Experimental History
sources.author: Adam Mastroianni
sources.notes: Former Columbia psych researcher. Challenges conventional wisdom with data. Rigorous, witty, surprising.

sources.name: Astral Codex Ten
sources.author: Scott Alexander
sources.notes: Rationalism, epistemology, decision-making. Long-form analytical essays. Deep WHY explorations.

sources.name: Aeon Magazine
sources.author: Various
sources.notes: Philosophy, science, culture. Accessible academic-quality long-form essays. Cross-disciplinary. Free.

sources.name: Noema Magazine
sources.author: Berggruen Institute
sources.notes: Philosophy, technology, society. Bold cross-disciplinary theses. Beautifully produced.

sources.name: Optimally Irrational
sources.author: Lionel Page
sources.notes: Behavioral economics professor. Biases, incentive design, decision-making. Rigorous + accessible.

sources.name: Default Wisdom
sources.author: Gurwinder Bhogal
sources.notes: Contrarian essays on human nature, biases, culture. Reframes familiar ideas.

sources.name: The Honest Broker
sources.author: Ted Gioia
sources.notes: Culture, history, counter-narrative. Challenges conventional wisdom. Consistently original theses.

sources.name: Works in Progress
sources.author: Various
sources.notes: Progress studies. Incentive design, institutional economics. Data-driven, bold arguments.

sources.name: Hidden Brain Newsletter
sources.author: Shankar Vedantam
sources.notes: Psychology of decision-making, identity, self-deception. Note: podcast-first site, newsletter is email-only; no reliable article RSS. Prefer discovery / transcribed pieces.

sources.name: The Spike
sources.author: Mark Humphries
sources.notes: Neuroscience research explained accessibly. Cognitive architecture, neural computation. Long-form, rigorous.

sources.name: Mind & Matter
sources.author: Nick Jikomes
sources.notes: Neuroscience, pharmacology, consciousness, altered states. Interviews + essays. Deep WHY focus.

sources.name: Neurofrontiers
sources.author: Various
sources.notes: Neuroplasticity, cognitive science, brain augmentation. Accessible academic research coverage.

sources.name: The Nature-Nurture-Nietzsche Newsletter
sources.author: Steve Stewart-Williams
sources.notes: Psychology, evolution, science, philosophy. Rigorous. Tackles topics others avoid.

sources.name: The Growth Equation
sources.author: Brad Stulberg
sources.notes: Peak performance, mastery, resilience. Grounded in science. No hustle-culture. Deep practice focus.

sources.name: Range Widely
sources.author: David Epstein
sources.notes: Generalist thinking, late specialization, human potential. Author of Range. Bold thesis territory.

sources.name: Farnam Street (Brain Food)
sources.author: Shane Parrish
sources.notes: Mental models, decision-making, mastery. Curated, high signal-to-noise. Weekly.

sources.name: The Profile
sources.author: Polina Marinova Pompliano
sources.notes: Deep profiles of high performers. Narrative psychology in action. Pattern recognition across lives.

sources.name: Quanta Magazine
sources.author: Simons Foundation
sources.notes: Frontier physics, math, biology. Accessible academic writing. Beautiful long-form. Free.

sources.name: Complexity Thoughts
sources.author: Manlio De Domenico
sources.notes: Complexity science papers curated and explained. Emergence, networks, self-organization.

sources.name: Santa Fe Institute Transmission
sources.author: SFI
sources.notes: Complexity, emergence, information theory. Direct from the premier complexity research institute.

sources.name: Melting Asphalt
sources.author: Kevin Simler
sources.notes: Human behavior through a systems-thinking lens. Signaling, cultural evolution, game theory. Infrequent but exceptional.

sources.name: Story Club
sources.author: George Saunders
sources.notes: Booker Prize winner on the craft of storytelling. Why stories work. Master-class quality.

sources.name: The Status Game
sources.author: Will Storr
sources.notes: Status, identity, narrative psychology. Bestselling author. Deep WHY explorations.

sources.name: Palladium Magazine
sources.author: Various
sources.notes: Governance, civilization, institutional narrative. Long-form, bold theses. Structural thinking.

sources.name: Culture Study
sources.author: Anne Helen Petersen
sources.notes: Culture, sociology, modern life. Structural analysis of social dynamics. Long-form.

sources.name: After Babel
sources.author: Jonathan Haidt + Zach Rausch
sources.notes: Technology, culture, childhood, social media effects. Data-driven. Challenges conventional wisdom.

sources.name: The Fitzwilliam
sources.author: Musa al-Gharbi (et al.)
sources.notes: Sociology of intellectual elites, symbolic professions, inequality. Bourdieusian lens. Bold.

sources.name: Warp News
sources.author: Various
sources.notes: Progress-focused counter-narrative to doom-scrolling. Data-driven optimism with substance.

sources.name: Marginal Revolution
sources.author: Tyler Cowen + Alex Tabarrok
sources.notes: Economics, culture, books, ideas. Eclectic, high volume but high signal. Daily — filter hard for long-form posts.

sources.name: Ribbonfarm
sources.author: Venkatesh Rao
sources.notes: Systems thinking, organizational theory, philosophy. Dense, original, structural.

sources.name: LessWrong (Curated)
sources.author: Community
sources.notes: Rationality, epistemology, decision theory. Bold theses. Rigorous. High ceiling. Use the CURATED feed only.
